sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Microfluidic Cartridges and Immunoassay Analyzers

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law and French civil law heritage under the Constitution of Vanuatu)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement is currently in force for Vanuatu; the following active tax and trade cooperation instruments apply.
Vanuatu–Australia Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA), signed 2 December 2008, in force 2010.
Vanuatu–New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA), signed 12 March 2009, in force 2011.
Vanuatu WTO accession effective 24 August 2012 with GATS establishment commitments.
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), in force for Vanuatu since 2020.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as amended through the beneficial-ownership amendments adopted in 2017-2019, ss. 17-18 (registered office and registered agent); Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Act No. 17 of 2006 (as amended), ss. 21-23 (customer due diligence, record keeping and reporting); VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook and Beneficial Ownership Administrative Guidelines issued by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of each shareholder, director, and beneficial owner's passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing national authority of the document holder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if source country is a Contracting State; otherwise consular legalization at the Vanuatu Embassy/Consulate or authorized agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized UBO declaration and source of wealth / anti-corruption statement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the resident jurisdiction of each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and account stability confirmation from an introducing regulated bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Regulated commercial bank maintaining the introducing account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good conduct / no criminal record or equivalent police clearance for each UBO and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent police or court authority in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / consular legalization as applicable unless exempted by VFSC rule

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC Sanctions List (SDN), EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Vanuatu domestic sanctions notifications. Continuous adverse-media and PEP screening is required under the VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook, with enhanced due diligence automatically applied to PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, or any linkage to medium-risk durable medical equipment procurement. No nominee exemption or waiver is available for International Companies.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Registry Portal (applications submitted through a VFSC-licensed registered agent)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Registered legal names are recorded in Latin script; any non-Latin name used commercially must be accompanied by an English/French/Bislama transliteration and must not be confusingly similar to an existing registered name. The legal name may be in English or French and must carry a recognized suffix denoting limited liability (e.g., 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Société Anonyme', 'SA'). Chinese or other non-Latin characters may appear only as a secondary trading name in the articles of association.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Vanuatu - only if the proposed name creates a misleading connection with the Republic of Vanuatu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 calendar days of written rejection, a formal appeal may be submitted through the VFSC-licensed registered agent with the prescribed appeal fee (approximately USD 50) and a comparative name-search report. The Registrar will respond within 15 working days. The 30-day reservation may be extended for one further 30-day period if applied before expiry. After a final appeal refusal, judicial review may be commenced in the Vanuatu Supreme Court within 21 days, and a fresh name application may be made after six months unless ministerial consent has been obtained for a sensitive token.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Allowed at incorporation stage: the International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu, which may be the licensed registered agent's address, and a virtual office arrangement is accepted for statutory correspondence. However, a virtual office cannot support a claim of local physical manufacturing, warehousing, or regulated medical-device dealings in Vanuatu; any such substance claim requires a fixed, identified physical facility and would trigger additional regulatory approvals.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (approximately 5% annual probability) for a passive offshore International Company with no local premises; elevated to 50-70% if the company records Vanuatu premises, claims economic substance in Vanuatu, or triggers VFSC/FIU risk flags for medical-device transaction patterns, PEP involvement, or unexplained third-party payments.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222), ss. 5, 6, 10, 18 and 129 (tax exemption); ancillary registration under the Business License Act [Cap. 244] and the Foreign Investment Act 2019; VFSC operating under the Financial Services Commission Act [Cap. 249]
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registrar of International Companies, Aru Street, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form 1) together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital required for an International Company; the Memorandum states authorized capital (commonly USD 10,000) and the escrow deposit is not a VFSC requirement. For foreign investors, the Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) requires proven availability of investment funds via bank statements as part of the Foreign Investment Certificate process.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the Company be and is hereby incorporated under the International Companies Act 1992 with registered number [IC No.], adopting the Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. (2) That the share subscriptions listed in the Application for Incorporation are approved and the directors are authorized to allot the stated issued capital accordingly. (3) That the registered office be established at [Port Vila address], and [Registered Agent] be appointed as registered agent. (4) That [Name] be appointed Director and [Name] be appointed Company Secretary of the Company. (5) That the officers are authorized, severally, to open banking accounts and to execute all filings required for the Vanuatu Business License and Foreign Investment Certificate. PASSED.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Search and Reservation with the VFSC Corporate Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Office, Corporate Affairs Department, Port Vila (lodged through a licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three ranked proposed company names each ending in 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' to the VFSC Registry using the official name reservation form. The VFSC verifies the names against the International Companies Register and domestic Companies Register and reserves an acceptable name for 14 days. A licensed Vanuatu registered agent must co-sign the name reservation because the agent is the statutory filing entity.
required_dossiers: Signed Name Reservation Request (Form NR-1)
Certified copy of subscriber passport
Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
Engagement letter of the Vanuatu registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused for similarity or undesirable character, the agent may refile with revised names within 5 business days; lapsed reservations must be re-submitted with a fresh reservation fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of the Incorporation Dossier
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent, acting with a local notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association, subscriber declarations, share subscription schedule, and director/secretary consents. The subscriber must execute wet-ink signatures before a notary public, and the registered agent must certify document conformity with the International Companies Act 1992 and the VFSC Anti-Money Laundering directives.
required_dossiers: Form 1 – Application for Incorporation of an International Company
Memorandum and Articles of Association IM&A
Subscriber declaration and share subscription schedule
Consent to Act as Director (Form D-1)
Consent to Act as Secretary (Form S-1)
Certified passport copy and proof of address of each subscriber and officer
Bank reference letter or source-of-funds statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues an administrative requisition, the registered agent must amend and re-notarize the affected schedule and resubmit within 7 days; a substantive rejection of the articles is cured by filing an Amended Memorandum with VFSC under s. 22 of the Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Form 1 and Payment of Statutory Fees to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Office (Corporate Affairs Department), Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the completed Form 1 together with the governing documents and the registered agent's consent through the agent's secure VFSC account. Pay the USD 250 government registration fee plus the VFSC service charge and the agent's professional fee. The application is receipted and queued for statutory review and legal compliance screening.
required_dossiers: Completed and notarized Form 1
Memorandum and Articles of Association IM&A
Consent of Registered Agent
VFSC filing fee receipt (USD 250 or VUV equivalent)
AML/KYC dossier of the beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a query notice is issued, file a written response with corrective documentation within 14 calendar days; non-response results in automatic rejection, and a revived application requires a new fee and re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon compliance verification, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation with a unique IC number. Collect the corporate kit comprising the certificate, memorandum and articles, share certificates, register of members, register of directors and secretaries, and company seal.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Concurrent Tax Exemption Certificate issued under s. 129 of the International Companies Act
Company seal and share certificates
Statutory registers and minutes book
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Clerical errors on the Certificate of Incorporation are cured by filing a Correction Request (Form COR-10) with a USD 25 fee; corrected certificates are normally reissued within 2 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Operational Registrations: VIPA, Business License, Customs and VAT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and Business License Office, Ministry of Finance; Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (VAT for taxable suppliers)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a Foreign Investment Certificate application to VIPA because the beneficial owner is non-resident. Obtain a Manufacturing Business License under the Business License Act [Cap. 244] describing the manufacture of microfluidic cartridges and assembly of immunoassay analyzers. Register for VAT if annual turnover is expected to exceed the mandatory threshold, open a customs code for importing cleanroom consumables, and register with the Vanuatu National Provident Fund as an employer.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Application form and business plan
Certificate of Incorporation
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Lease agreement of the Port Vila manufacturing premises
Facility description, cleanroom layout and staff plan
DEPC environmental registration confirmation
Business License application form (BL-1)
Certified identity documents of directors and ultimate beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Business License is refused on zoning or environmental grounds, appeal to the Minister of Finance under the Business License Act within 30 days; concurrently secure an alternative compliant premise or an amended DEPC registration and resubmit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) in conjunction with the Business License Office of the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Health (medical device import/distribution notification)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Certificate (FIC) and Manufacturing Business License (Category: Manufacturing and Processing of Medical Diagnostic Devices) under the Business License Act [Cap. 244]

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC) of the Ministry of Climate Change, Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 – Registration and Preliminary Environmental Review; a Full EIA Report is not required for cleanroom microfluidic cartridge assembly, but DEPC may elevate the project to Category 1 (Full EIA) if on-site biological reagent synthesis exceeds 1,000 kg per year or any untreated liquid effluent is discharged off-premises.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Environmental Protection and Conservation Act [Cap. 283] and the Environment (EIA) Regulations 2005: wastewater pH 6.0–9.0, BOD5 ≤ 50 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, total coliforms ≤ 1,000/100 mL, oil and grease ≤ 10 mg/L; airborne VOC emissions within ISO 14644-1 Class 7 cleanroom limits; all biological and immunoassay waste must be autoclaved on-site and removed by a DEPC-licensed waste contractor with a full chain-of-custody manifest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services (VFES) prior to commencement of production; structural and load inspection by the Public Works Department building control section for the analyzer assembly line; occupational health and safety clearance under the Employment Act [Cap. 160] covering chemical storage, hazard signage and emergency exits; and an ISO 13485 quality management system certification aligned with the Ministry of Health notification requirements for IVD analyzers and point-of-care devices.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), operating as the Customs and Inland Revenue Department under the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official taxpayer portal and procedures administered through VRC Port Vila (e-services via the Government of Vanuatu online platform and the VRC tax office, Port Vila).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Confirm nexus — a VU International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] is non-resident and statutorily exempt from Vanuatu income tax and VAT; no tax ID is required for pure offshore activity. Step 2: If the IC establishes a physical Vanuatu presence or makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu exceeding VUV 5,000,000 in any 12-month period, it must apply to VRC for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and VAT registration within 21 days. Step 3: File the standard VAT registration application (Form VAT 001) with certified constitutional documents, the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, registered office and agent details, and a local representative/agent appointment letter. Step 4: VRC issues the TIN certificate referencing the statutory VAT number within 7–14 business days; the applicant must file a VAT return and maintain a local agent for service of process. Step 5: Foreign entities without a Vanuatu bank/tax nexus may alternatively obtain a TIN for customs purposes only when transacting physical imports/exports through Vanuatu Customs.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election or hybrid-mismatch election exists in Vanuatu domestic law. The IC enjoys an automatic, non-electable statutory tax exemption under section 8 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], covering all Vanuatu taxes, stamp duties, and exchange-control restrictions for non-resident operations. The only elective feature is in the IC's constitution (e.g., election of redenomination currency or share capital currency for VFSC registration purposes); no entity-classification election is required or available because the IC is deemed a non-resident exempt vehicle. A corporate 'opt-in' to local tax liability occurs only if the IC engages in prohibited domestic business in Vanuatu without a licence, in which case it may lose statutory exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover per VAT Act No. 13 of 2019 (income-tax-exempt ICs manufacturing offshore with no Vanuatu supplies remain unregistered and outside the VAT net).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None currently in force: Vanuatu has not introduced mandatory real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping for VAT invoices. Tax invoices under the VAT Act 2019 must contain the prescribed particulars (supplier name and TIN/VAT number, customer identification where above threshold, serial number, date, description, quantity, consideration, and VAT charged), but paper/PDF issuance is accepted. VRC retains audit rights to require certified invoice summaries and performs system-based verification through the VAT return filing portal.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods: a supply of goods is zero-rated under the VAT Act No. 13 of 2019 where the goods are physically exported from Vanuatu by or on behalf of the supplier within the prescribed period (customs-controlled export) and the supplier retains commercial and transport evidence. Offshore services: services supplied to a non-resident person are zero-rated where they are performed for use and enjoyment entirely outside Vanuatu and do not relate to land or goods in Vanuatu; supplies to international carriers engaged in international transport are also zero-rated. An exempt VU_IC manufacturing microfluidic cartridges and immunoassay analyzers offshore for foreign distributors generally has no Vanuatu VAT exposure, provided no supply is made to a Vanuatu resident and no goods physically enter Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Vanuatu Single Administrative Document) — proof of customs clearance at the port of export
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill — independent carrier evidence that goods left Vanuatu and were delivered to the foreign buyer
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 foreign-currency credit advice — proof of payment receipt and FX repatriation
Commercial Invoice and Packing List — matching description, quantity, and value of the zero-rated supply
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The VRC Commissioner is empowered under the VAT Act 2019 to audit all zero-rated export claims; where export documentation is missing, incomplete, or inconsistent, the zero-rating is retrospectively reversed, output VAT at 12.5% is clawed back with statutory interest, and input VAT credits are disallowed. Fraudulent or reckless zero-rating claims (false declarations, collusive over-invoicing, use of fake customs or bill-of-lading documents) constitute criminal offences under both the VAT Act and Customs Act, punishable on conviction with substantial fines and/or imprisonment; the Customs Act additionally permits seizure of goods, forfeiture of vehicles and vessels, and monetary penalties up to a multiple of the duty evaded, while the VAT Act imposes penalty tax (up to 100% of the tax understatement) and suspension or cancellation of the trader's VAT registration.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberalised exchange-control regime for non-resident entities. The Vatu (VUV) is a managed-float currency administered by the RBV, with active trading through authorized dealers; the VUV is not a global offshore-deliverable currency, so substantive international transactions should be denominated in AUD, USD, EUR or NZD. For International Companies (ICs) classified as non-resident for exchange-control purposes, capital-account transactions such as equity injection and shareholder loans may be freely routed through licensed banks without prior RBV approval. Current-account payments, including trade settlement and profit remittance, are equally unrestricted for non-residents; however, all payments are subject to the delegated oversight of authorized dealers under the Exchange Control Act and to Anti-Money Laundering/Countering the Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) reporting through the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit. Vanuatu imposes no income tax, dividend withholding tax, or capital gains tax on ICs or their non-resident shareholders; therefore, profit and dividend remittances face minimal statutory tax hurdles but require robust provenance documentation to satisfy bank compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu has no mandatory export-proceeds surrender regime. An International Company in the IVD manufacturing segment may retain all export and trade-related foreign currency proceeds in offshore or onshore foreign currency accounts without any statutory requirement to convert VUV within a prescribed timeline. The RBV Exchange Control Act delegates custody and transfer control to licensed authorized dealers; in practice, where VUV conversion is needed for local expenses, conversion is executed at prevailing market rates. The entity should, however, maintain a transaction file for each export receipt, including contract, commercial invoice, bill of lading, customs declaration and source-of-funds records, because banks may require such evidence under delegated exchange-control and AML/CFT reporting obligations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-currency Operational Account / Trade Finance Account with Swift and LC capabilities
Operational Account / Foreign Currency Account / Trade Settlement Account
Operational VUV Account only; limited cross-border trade support

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low-to-Medium. Fully digital offshore Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) are not authorized to provide domestic payment services to Vanuatu International Companies unless they obtain a deposit-taking or e-money license under the RBV Banking Act. Unlicensed offshore EMIs cannot open a Vanuatu settlement account nor issue a Vanuatu IBAN, and Vanuatu banks generally de-risk from fintech aggregators because of FATF and correspondent-banking sensitivity. A viable structuring solution is the use of an EMU- or UK-regulated EMI merely as a pre-fundedP payment-collection vehicle for inbound third-party customer payments from markets where fast card/SWIFT acceptance is required, while the principal treasury settlement remains with an RBV-licensed commercial bank. Legal constraints include the absence of deposit insurance for foreign corporates, restricted VUV denomiation management, and the need to pass through the responsible-persons and AML/CFT requirements under the Vanuatu Financial Institutions Supervision Framework.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence and KYC interview mandate: In practice, Vanuatu commercial banks mandate the physical appearance of at least one director and all authorised signatories, or the appearance of a locally resident corporate agent holding a notarised Power of Attorney, for the initial account onboarding of an International Company. Remote video-KYC account opening is rarely available for manufacturing/trading entities because the underlying beneficial-ownership structure of an IC is considered higher risk. For the ISIC 3250 automated point-of-care IVD equipment business, the bank’s AML/TF risk engine will normally require either (a) an in-person interview at the bank’s Port Vila or Santo branch, or (b) a certified KYC interview conducted by a Vanuatu in-house counsel or licensed corporate manager, backed by passport-certified copies and a registered office certificate. The exact standard varies by bank, with ANZ historically accepting remote sign-up only after an existing-bank reference and when the UBO has a relationship with another ANZ branch in the region.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO chain obscured through offshore International Company structure with nominee directors or nominee shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered office certificate issued by the licensed Vanuatu registered agent; full corporate registry extract showing director and shareholder details; a notarised declaration of trust or trust deed for any nominee arrangement; passport copies of all immediate and ultimate beneficial owners; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds questionnaires; audited or management-prepared financial statements for any operating subsidiaries; and a current tax-residence certificate for each UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between the Vanuatu International Company domicile and the physical manufacturing operations for IVD instruments and microfluidic cartridges
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Manufacturing and supply-chain documentation: equipment lease agreements, factory photographs, fire-safety and zoning approvals from the true operating jurisdiction, quality-management certificates (ISO 13485, ISO 9001), product CE-IVD or FDA-equivalent registration certificates, third-party inspection reports, purchase orders and sales contracts showing genuine global trade; intercompany service agreement with the foreign IVD manufacturing affiliate; and the entity’s detailed business plan for distribution in Vanuatu and Pacific islands.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-finance exposure to high-risk medical/IVD goods and potential circumvention of export-control or import quarantine requirements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Country-of-origin certificates, export licenses or prior notification approvals from the manufacturing country’s health regulator; commercial invoices with correct Incoterms; shipper’s export declaration; bills of lading or airway bills; packing lists; insurance certificates; UCP600-compliant LC drafts if a letter of credit is used; and a written attestation that no product is related to weapons, dual-use biological agents, or controlled substances.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound equity injection from a jurisdiction or entity not clearly explained by the company's commercial history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder resolution approving the capital injection; loan subscription agreement or share issuance document; proof of identity and source of funds for the remitting shareholder (bank statements, dividend vouchers, exit proceeds from a legitiimately disclosed transaction); a professional due-diligence report on the remitting entity prepared by a licensed KYC/AML provider; a sworn affidavit explaining the economic rationale for the placement; and prior-period bank statements showing the corporate treasury was clean and audited.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The compliant liquidity-injection route is a direct SWIFT MT103 wire from the shareholder’s audited bank account to the IC’s operational foreign-currency account at an RBV-licensed commercial bank. The purpose-of-remittance field must clearly state 'Equity contribution to Vanuatu International Company for working capital, IVD equipment trading and trade finance.' For accounting and regulatory mapping, the bank will align the post to an international balance-of-payments capital-account category; the entity should consistently record the transaction as paid-in capital or shareholder loan with a corresponding entry in its IFRS financial statements. The remitting bank will require a board resolution, the IC registration number, the UBO declaration, a certificate of good standing, and a source-of-funds letter. All inbound wires should be designated in USD, AUD, EUR, or NZD, and not in VUV, to preserve exchange-control clarity and to avoid unnecessary conversion spread. Payments from third parties or crypto-linked money-service businesses are prohibited and will trigger automatic compliance refusal.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound trade settlements, the primary clearing rails are SWIFT MT103 for open-account payments and Commercial Letters of Credit (documentary LC). For open-account supplier payments, the IC must issue a MT103 payment instruction referencing the production invoice number, commodity description, Incoterms, and end-to-end reference ID through its banking portal. For LC-based procurement, the Vanuatu issuing bank will transmit the documentary credit via SWIFT MT700; the exporting supplier’s bank presents complying documents, then settlement occurs through reimbursement in the LC currency. The IC treasury should maintain a segregated USD/AUD trade account and use no VUV conversion unless a local expense is involved. Acceptable outbound settlement documentation set includes the commercial invoice, comprehensive packing list, full bill of lading, certificate of origin, inspection certificate, and the LC negotiated draft. Where respondent banks in the United States are involved, the IC must beware of correspondent-bank compliance scrutiny and should provide the full beneficial-ownership chain and trade paperwork at the initiation of each LC or high-value MT103 to mitigate potential sanctions-screening delays.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright forward foreign-exchange contracts (deliverable VUV or cross-currency) executed with an RBV-licensed authorized dealer with underlying trade exposure documentation
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/VUV to hedge currency exposure where actual VUV settlement offshore is not required
Cross-currency swaps between USD and AUD/EUR for term-balance-sheet flexibility, subject to bank credit approval and treasury-policy sign-off
Plain-vanilla FX options (European-style) for hedging trade receivables and payables without speculation
Interest-rate and cross-currency basis swaps only for hedging genuine hard-currency liabilities related to equipment financing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of an International Company (corporate declaration covering registered agent, registered office, shareholders, directors, and beneficial ownership confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 calendar days after the anniversary date of incorporation (anniversary rule); if the due date falls on a non-business day, the next business day.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late annual return attracts a fixed penalty of VUV 25,000; continued non-filing for 60 days triggers a Notice of Default from the registrar, and if not remedied within 6 months the company is administratively struck off the International Companies Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Prescribed Franchise / Renewal Fee for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Revenue and Compliance Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary date of incorporation, with a 30-day grace window if submitted together with the annual return; no calendar-year professional filing is required for an exempt International Company.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid fees bear a compounding 2% monthly penalty; after 60 days VFSC will decline all statutory services and certificate issuance; after 6 months the Registrar may strike off and dissolve the company without further notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None under the International Companies Act (Cap 222); an International Company is exempt from financial audit unless the memorandum or articles require it, shareholders pass an audit resolution, a lender or investor covenant demands it, or the company voluntarily obtains an audit for ISO 13485 certification or distributor qualification.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vanuatu law does not prescribe a mandatory accounting framework for exempt International Companies. If financial statements are prepared, the directors may select IFRS as issued by the IASB or another recognized national GAAP (such as US GAAP) documented in the accounting policy note; no local GAAP filing is made to VFSC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must keep its statutory registers at the registered agent's office in Vanuatu. The registered agent must maintain a beneficial ownership register and obtain a signed annual confirmation from the directors identifying all individuals who directly or indirectly hold 10% or more, or who exercise control, of the company. Any material change during the year (share transfer, allotment, change of director) must be reflected immediately, and a notice of change must be lodged with VFSC within 21 days of the annual confirmation event; non-compliance is a criminal offence subject to a maximum fine of VUV 2,000,000.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 – 1,500 per annum for a licensed Vanuatu registered agent including registered office and secretarial compliance
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000 – 20,000 per engagement if a voluntary audit is required for ISO 13485, bank financing, or distribution contracts

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory zero-tax regime under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]: an International Company (IC) pays no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no dividend withholding tax, no payroll tax, and no stamp duty on offshore instruments. The only recurrent statutory impost is the VFSC annual renewal/license fee. The manufacturing of automated point-of-care IVD microfluidic cartridges and immunoassay analyzers conducted wholly outside Vanuatu preserves the exemption.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return for International Companies (IC Act, Schedule Form 1) filed by the licensed Vanuatu registered agent through the VFSC Registry online portal (www.vfsc.vu). No corporate income tax return exists for an IC because the entity is outside the Vanuatu income tax net.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the anniversary date of incorporation each year. Late filing attracts an immediate penalty; default continuing for three months triggers the VFSC striking-off notice process, with dissolution of the IC after six months of continued non-compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered company name and VFSC registration number of the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact certificate name; no translation is accepted. Non-resident beneficial ownership is confidential and not disclosed on the public face of this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Street address of the registered office in Vanuatu maintained by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The address is provided by the Vanuatu agent; it must be a physical location open during business hours and must not be a P.O. Box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and license number of the VFSC-licensed registered agent responsible for the IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent is the statutory point of contact with Vanuatu authorities; non-resident directors cannot replace or bypass the agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names of all current directors; a copy of the director register must be physically held by the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-resident and need never travel to Vanuatu; however, the agent must retain identity and verification documents under AML rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of issued shares, share classes, and aggregate nominal or paid-up capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital is prescribed for an IC; the declaration of paid-up or deemed capital may be completed by the agent. Registry access is restricted and the entry is not public.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that a beneficial ownership register is maintained by the agent identifying every ultimate natural-person owner.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial owners may be non-resident; the register is not filed for public inspection but must be produced to VFSC and to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit upon lawful request.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signed declaration that the IC has not conducted prohibited domestic business in Vanuatu (section 8 of the IC Act) and has otherwise complied with the Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The declaration must be signed by a director, the company secretary, or the registered agent; a false certification is a criminal offence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty accrues automatically from day 31 after the anniversary (approximately VUV 5,000 per month or part thereof, subject to VFSC fee schedule revisions); non-payment of the annual fee for three months, followed by statutory notice and six months' continued arrears, results in strike-off and dissolution of the IC. Reinstatement is at VFSC discretion, conditional on payment of arrears and renewed agent compliance.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions from an International Company; profits, dividends, and liquidation surpluses may be repatriated tax-free to any jurisdiction via Swift LC or TT wire.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double tax agreement network and no treaty-relief procedure or Tax Residence Certificate for ICs. A shareholder claiming treaty benefits must do so in the recipient jurisdiction under that jurisdiction's own treaty and foreign-tax-credit or CFC rules; Vanuatu issues no certificate of fiscal residence for an IC.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on royalties, license fees, and interest paid by an IC; because Vanuatu has no income tax and no DTA network, no treaty-reduced rates are available. Cross-border leakage arises only in the source country of the payee under foreign CFC, FDII, or EU anti-hybrid rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - Vanuatu has no general transfer-pricing legislation, no Local File or Master File regime, and no controlled-transaction documentation threshold for International Companies. The zero-tax regime eliminates any Vanuatu arm's-length adjustment. Intra-group pricing of IVD cartridges, analyzer hardware, and IP royalties remains material to foreign tax authorities through CFC, permanent establishment, and base-erosion rules.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's Economic Substance (Companies) Act applies to VFSC-license-holding entities conducting relevant activities (banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing, leasing, headquarters, distribution, or service centres). A pure IC manufacturing microfluidic cartridges and immunoassay analyzers outside Vanuatu falls outside the domestic economic substance verification net; however, genuine foreign substance must still be demonstrable to prevent foreign CFC attribution, permanent-establishment risk, and EU/G20 listing countermeasures.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC as a passive invoicing and bank-account shell to divert manufacturing or IVD equipment sales profits actually earned in the beneficial owner's home jurisdiction, without real operational substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu: strike-off and dissolution by VFSC for failure to maintain an agent and records; the exemption does not shield beneficial owners. Foreign: recharacterization of the IC as a sham, full reassessment, penalties of 100-200% of understated tax, debanking, and inclusion on CFC registries.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign false compliance declarations are criminally liable under the IC Act (fine and imprisonment); in foreign proceedings, directors face civil restitution for diverted profits, travel bans, and extradition or conviction for tax fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Carrying on business with Vanuatu residents, owning or leasing Vanuatu land, conducting banking or insurance business, or operating a domestic IVD manufacturing activity without a local business license - in breach of section 8 of the IC Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of the IC's exempt status, VFSC deregistration, fines per offence, voiding of prohibited contracts, and forfeiture of assets connected to the unlawful domestic business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally and jointly liable for the company's debts arising from prohibited domestic contracts; the corporate veil is pierced and personal assets are exposed to civil enforcement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain an accurate beneficial ownership register, concealment of the ultimate natural-person owner, or non-identification of a sanctioned party behind the IVD manufacturing entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties under the International Companies (Amendment) Act and the Financial Transactions Reporting Act, referral to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, publication of non-compliance, and deregistration for repeat breaches.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of nominee structures face personal fines, confiscation of unexplained wealth, and imprisonment for money laundering or proceeds-of-crime offences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Manufacturing, importing, or distributing automated point-of-care IVD devices from Vanuatu without Ministry of Health device approval and VFSC trade licensing, or conducting financial or insurance services without a VFSC licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of the IC registration, monetary penalties per unlicensed operation, seizure of medical devices, and freezing of operational bank accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for unlicensed trading debts and may be disqualified; criminal liability attaches to those who knowingly operate an unlicensed IVD-manufacturing or financial business.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting an annual return or compliance declaration with materially false information - fake director identities, fictitious capital, or false certification that no prohibited domestic business was conducted.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal offence under the IC Act: fines of up to three times the advantage obtained, mandatory deregistration, and referral to the Public Prosecutor for prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Imprisonment for fraud-related offences, disqualification as director of Vanuatu companies, and civil liability to third parties who relied on the false filing.
